name: getwowlink
description: Check how links look when shared (Open Graph and Twitter card tags) and make OG images for every page of a site.

interface.longDescription:
See how a link looks when it's shared on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Slack, WhatsApp and Telegram, and fix what's wrong.

Check one page and get a score, how each platform shows the card, and the og: and twitter: tags to fix. Check a whole site, up to 50 pages from its sitemap, and find pages with no image, the same image everywhere, or broken tags. Each check comes with a visual report on getwowlink.com.

With a getwowlink account, ChatGPT can also have branded Open Graph images designed for every page of your site. getwowlink designs them from your site, you pick one and publish it on getwowlink.com (ChatGPT never publishes for you), then ChatGPT gives you the og:image tags to add to your site and checks them once they're live.
capabilities: Check link previews across a site
Design OG images for a site
Give the OG tags to install
defaultPrompt: Check how my homepage looks when shared on LinkedIn and X
Find pages on my site with missing or broken preview images
Make Open Graph images for every page of my site

positive.prompt: How does https://www.getwowlink.com/pricing look when shared on LinkedIn and X?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the page's preview score, the title, description and image each platform shows, the og:/twitter: tags to fix if any, and a link to the visual report on getwowlink.com.

positive.description: Check the previews of a whole site
positive.prompt: Check the link previews on every page of getwowlink.com
positive.expected_behavior: Checks up to 50 pages from the sitemap (calling again with check_id while it runs) and summarises how many pages have no image, share one image or are broken, with a link to the site report.

positive.description: Design OG images for a site in the demo account
positive.prompt: Make Open Graph images for my site {{demoSite}}
positive.expected_behavior: Starts AI designs for the site and prints the getwowlink link where the person picks a design and presses Publish. It doesn't publish anything itself.

positive.description: Get the tags for a site whose design is published
positive.prompt: The design for {{demoSite}} is published. What tags do I add to my site?
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the design is published, then gives the og:image and twitter:image tags with the getwowimg.com image URL pattern for each page of the site.

positive.description: Verify the installed tags on a live site
positive.prompt: I've deployed the OG tags on {{demoSite}}. Check that they work.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the live pages: each has exactly one og:image served by getwowlink, and says whether crawlers already fetch the images.

negative.description: Writing a social post is not a link preview check; no getwowlink tool should run.
negative.prompt: Write a tweet announcing my product launch.

negative.description: There is no tool to delete accounts; ChatGPT should say so and point to getwowlink support instead of calling a tool.
negative.prompt: Delete my getwowlink account and all my sites.

negative.description: An unrelated question; no getwowlink tool should run.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Dubai tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. Paid getwowlink plans are bought on getwowlink.com; when an account reaches a plan limit, the app says so and links to the informational plans page.

publication.release_notes: First release: check link previews for a page or a whole site, design OG images for a site, get the tags to install and verify them.
